implementation: CN4010, CN4020, CN6010 and CN6140 Series Common Crypto Library
description: The CN4010, CN4020, CN6010 and CN6140 Series Common Crypto Library Module provides FIPS 140-2 approved cryptographic algorithms for CN4010, CN4020, CN6010 and CN6140 Series Encryptors. Based upon OpenSSL the Common Crypto Library provides an Application Programming Interface (API) to support security relevant services.
vendor: Senetas Corporation Ltd, distributed by Gemalto NV (SafeNet)
